game.title: LEGO® Batman™: Legacy of the Dark Knight

roadmap.title: Story and early upgrades
roadmap.description: Finish the story on a difficulty you enjoy. Buy useful skills and gadget upgrades, use stealth when possible, and stop crimes while traveling. Missed mission collectibles can be recovered at the Batcomputer.

roadmap.title: Gotham and collection cleanup
roadmap.description: Hack all district radio towers with Batgirl, complete the district checklists and replay missions for missing collectibles. Finish the shop collections, collect 25 Bat-Symbols and earn five AR gold medals.

roadmap.title: Mayhem Mode
roadmap.description: Use the Deluxe Edition Upgrade’s Mayhem content. Escape Arkham, improve the hideout and play repeated runs for the main objectives, crew, purchases, stolen vehicles and sewer exits.

steps.text: Finish every base-game achievement; the Mayhem Mode achievements are excluded.
Complete Chapter Six and its final battle.

achievements.description: Complete every side activity in Gotham

steps.text: After finishing the story, use Batgirl's @item{Hackarang} on the radio tower in each district to reveal its activity markers.
Clear the activities in each district's map checklist. Follow new Falcone quests and puzzle rooms as they appear until every district is complete.

achievements.summary: Complete the base game’s 100% collectible collection.

guide.context: Bat-Symbols, blue stud caches and bonus Brutal Bat trophies do not count toward this achievement.

steps.text: Finish the story, then clear all nine district checklists. Hack their radio towers with Batgirl to reveal collectible markers.
Use @loc{Batcomputer} mission replay to collect missing story trophy parts, WayneTech Caches and Red Bricks. Check the collectible counters for each replay.
Buy the remaining required suits, vehicles and Red Bricks. Complete side-activity milestones for their rewards, and collect all Skill Bricks.

guide.context: Promotional outfits, account-link rewards and extra paid suits are excluded.

steps.text: Complete the story and activity milestones for WayneTech Caches, puzzles, AR Trials, zoo animals, Plantlife, Wanted Posters, Falcone Fortune and the Case of Waylon Jones.
Buy the remaining suits at @loc{Bat-Mite: The Store}. Check the suit collection for any missing base-game outfit.

achievements.displayName: "Wanna know how I got these cars?"

guide.context: Vehicles from external promotions are excluded.

steps.text: Finish the story and complete AR Trials, WayneTech Caches, zoo animals, Plantlife, Falcone Fortune, SubWayne stations and the Case of Waylon Jones for vehicle rewards.
Visit the @loc{Batcave Garage} and buy every remaining required vehicle, including vehicles made available by those milestones.

achievements.summary: Purchase every Combat and Exploration skill.

steps.text: Earn the 30 @item{Skill Bricks} from story missions and Gotham side activities.
Spend those bricks on every skill in both menu categories: @mechanic{Combat} and @mechanic{Exploration}.

achievements.displayName: "This is too much power for one person."
achievements.summary: Obtain all 23 required Red Brick modifiers.

guide.context: Recover missed mission bricks with Batcomputer replay. The nine shop modifiers also count; the bonus modifier is excluded.

collectibles.name: Ninja
collectibles.location: Infiltration: snowy ledge below the railing
collectibles.method: After the railing takedown, drop to the lower railing on the right. Follow it to the snowy opening. Put the two book stacks on two floor plates, then use Bruce and Talia on the other pair.

collectibles.name: Nautical
collectibles.location: New Beginnings: beside Flass's donut shop
collectibles.method: Climb the building immediately left of the donut shop. Enter through its skylight.

collectibles.name: Filthy Rich
collectibles.location: Carmine Falcone: VIP Lounge safe
collectibles.method: Enter 596 on the safe wheels in the VIP Lounge.

collectibles.name: Toxic Waste
collectibles.location: Red Hood Gang: pipe room after glass floor
collectibles.method: After crossing the glass floor above the party, crawl through the opening on the right. Use Gordon's foam on the left pipe, then the next pipe receiving the brick. Pull the claw point over the window, grapple out, and foam the final outlet before collecting the brick.

collectibles.name: Feline
collectibles.location: Mimes: GADGETS display
collectibles.method: Connect the loose cable to the screen. Use the floor arrows to steer the green cat through the maze to the red exit square.

collectibles.name: Gothic
collectibles.location: The Penguin: storage after penguin exhibit
collectibles.method: Break objects beside Oswald's portrait and crawl through the vent. Cut the glass around the red umbrella and install that umbrella on the stand. Aim the umbrella at the brick's cage with Catwoman's whip and jump on the firing plunger.

collectibles.name: Artist
collectibles.location: The Flugelheim: security room
collectibles.method: Control Catwoman's kitty in the security room. Climb the books onto the desk, cross the shelves, and enter the hatch.

collectibles.name: Showbiz
collectibles.location: Joker parade: between jungle and castle floats
collectibles.method: Grapple to the right-side perches and cross the tightrope to the balcony. Cut the window and call a kitty inside. Jump from the table onto the TV, then switch to Batman and push the TV left. Return to the kitty and climb to the bookshelf hatch.

collectibles.name: Clown
collectibles.location: Two-Face: circus strength tester
collectibles.method: Step on the strength-test button beside the circus ring. Hit the three revealed targets quickly with Robin's birdarang.

collectibles.name: Power Plant
collectibles.location: Kite-Man: locked side room before first pod
collectibles.method: Pry open the door off the walkway. Connect the power cell to the wall generator with Robin's cable launcher. Move the staff socket right to close the pipe. Let Robin hold the socket while Batman glides upward on the air current. Return to Robin and move the socket left, letting Batman land beside the brick.

collectibles.name: Flower Power
collectibles.location: Poison Ivy: side greenhouse
collectibles.method: Find the greenhouse beside the door with the claw point. Put the red plant and green plant into the two crossbreeding slots to open the glass dome.

collectibles.name: Fire Breather
collectibles.location: Firefly: globe before space exhibit
collectibles.method: Enter the side room to the right before the space exhibit. Turn each of the four globe wheels until every projection shows Mars.

collectibles.name: Ice Age
collectibles.location: Mr. Freeze: wall opposite freeze cannon
collectibles.method: Once Nightwing joins, throw Batgirl's hackarang at the wall panel across from the cannon. Strike the three exposed circuit breakers with Nightwing's electrorang, starting on the right and working left.

collectibles.name: Bats
collectibles.location: A Shadow Over Gotham: Tumbler street
collectibles.method: On returning to the street, turn back toward the barriers. Charge the garbage truck's staff socket with Nightwing and quick-hack the revealed panel with Batgirl. Stay behind the moving truck as cover and pick up the brick in the road.

collectibles.name: Nine shop modifiers
collectibles.location: Bat-Mite: The Store, behind the main Batcave lift.
collectibles.method: Buy the Red Brick modifiers from the shop display as its stock changes until all nine are owned.

steps.text: Check the @loc{Challenge Board} above the Batcave exit road. Complete 20 of its listed objectives.

achievements.displayName: "It's a big city. I can't be everywhere."

steps.text: Unlock the first station during @loc{Wayne Enterprises}, then solve the shutter puzzle at the SubWayne marker in each of the other eight districts.

achievements.summary: Make Jim Gordon a playable ally.

steps.text: Complete @loc{New Beginnings} in Chapter One.
Play @loc{Mimes} at Shreck's Department Store in Chapter Two.
Play the @enemy{Two-Face} mission at Haly's Circus in Chapter Three.
Play @loc{Batgirl Begins} in Chapter Four.
Play the @enemy{Mr. Freeze} mission in Chapter Four.
Play @loc{Tumbler Chase} in Chapter Five.

Visit Tricorner, Old Gotham South, Old Gotham North, Old Gotham West, The Cauldron South, The Cauldron North, Newtown, Gotham Village–Robinson Park and East End–Amusement Mile as the story opens the city.

achievements.description: Purchase all Gadget Upgrades for any single character
achievements.summary: Buy the full set of gadget upgrades for one character.

guide.context: WayneTech Caches and story missions award the chips. Batman has a larger, more expensive upgrade set.

steps.text: At the @loc{Workbench} beside the Batcave lift, spend 56 WayneTech Chips on all eight gadget upgrades for Jim Gordon, Catwoman, Robin or Batgirl.

achievements.summary: Assemble Bruce’s complete Gray Ghost outfit.

steps.text: During the opening garden sequence, use @mechanic{Detect} to find the Gray Ghost costume pieces and collect them.
Finish Bruce's League of Shadows training and escape from Ra's al Ghul. Continue until Bruce and Alfred discover the Batcave.
Complete the @loc{Red Hood Gang} mission at ACE Chemicals.
Stop @enemy{Joker} during the parade mission, @loc{The Big Dukeroo}.
Defeat @enemy{Poison Ivy} at the Botanical Gardens.
Defeat @enemy{Mr. Freeze} in @loc{The Ice Man Cometh}.
Complete @loc{Tumbler Chase}.
Hack each district radio tower with Batgirl. Use @mechanic{Detect} beside locked caches to trace wires and puzzle parts, then switch to the character whose gadget opens the way.
Search the @loc{Batcave} as well: caches sit beneath walkways and stairs, beside the main lift, inside the Suit Vault and in the purchased expansions.
Replay story missions at the @loc{Batcomputer} for the 40 mission caches. Check each mission's collectible counter before moving on.

achievements.summary: Finish every Riddler and Cluemaster puzzle room.

guide.context: Completing one room can open another, so a district may gain a new puzzle marker later.

steps.text: Collect the marked Riddler and Cluemaster puzzle boxes and clear the rooms they unlock. Keep checking the map for the next room in each chain.
If a puzzle stops your progress, enable @mechanic{Event Skipping} in Accessibility and use the skip prompt.

achievements.description: Purchase a Skill Upgrade from each category
achievements.summary: Buy a skill in Combat and a skill in Exploration.

steps.text: After the tutorial purchase of @mechanic{Critical Hits} in Combat, spend a Skill Brick on any @mechanic{Exploration} skill.
Spend @item{WayneTech Chips} on three upgrades at the @loc{Workbench} beside the Batcave lift.
After the story purchase of the Suit Vault, buy the Training Area for 50,000 studs, Display Area for 75,000, Science Lab for 100,000 and Clean Slate for 100,000.
Find Clean Slate below the Challenge Board and Display Area behind the Batcomputer. The Science Lab is in the north manor foundations. The Training Area is in the south manor foundations.

achievements.description: Place 5 Props or Trophies in the Batcave
achievements.summary: Display five props or trophies inside the Batcave.

steps.text: Stand beside a LEGO baseplate in the Batcave and open its customization prompt. Place five owned decorations.

achievements.summary: Buy three vehicles at the Batcave Garage.

steps.text: Use the Garage in the center of the Batcave to purchase three vehicles. The Batman ’89 car costs only 1,000 studs.
Enter @loc{Bat-Mite: The Store} behind the Batcave's main lift after its Chapter Two introduction and make five purchases.

achievements.summary: Apply a Red Brick color modifier.

steps.text: Open a character's customization menu, choose @mechanic{Vehicle Options}, and apply one unlocked Red Brick modifier.

achievements.description: Get 5 Gold Medals in AR Trials
achievements.summary: Earn gold medals in five distinct AR Trials.

steps.text: Start five different AR Trials and beat each trial's gold target. Retry any trial where you earn a lower medal.
For combat trials, use Jim Gordon's @item{Rebound Launcher} with its first split-bolt upgrade to hit groups quickly.

achievements.description: Cash in a Challenge in the Batcave
achievements.summary: Claim one completed Challenge Board reward.

steps.text: Return to the @loc{Challenge Board} above the Batcave exit road and claim any finished challenge.

achievements.description: Roll the camera over 20 degrees in Photo Mode
achievements.summary: Tilt Photo Mode’s camera past 20 degrees of roll.

steps.text: Pause and enter @mechanic{Photo Mode}. Hold a camera-roll control until the horizon tilts beyond 20 degrees.

achievements.description: Change the screensaver on the Batcomputer

steps.text: Stand at the @loc{Batcomputer} and use the screensaver customization prompt. Select a different design.

achievements.summary: Earn a cumulative total of one million studs.

guide.context: Studs you spend still count toward lifetime earnings.

steps.text: Collect studs from enemies, breakable scenery and activities until your total earnings reach 1,000,000.
Press the @mechanic{Counter} input when the counter prompt appears over an attacking enemy. Build up 100 successful counters across fights.

achievements.description: Collect 30,000 Studs within a single stud combo
achievements.summary: Earn 30,000 studs during one continuous stud combo.

steps.text: Purchase @mechanic{Hyper Combo} and @mechanic{Stud Magnet} in Exploration. Replay the Falcone club mission at the Batcomputer.
Break the club's furniture and keep collecting the dropped studs without letting the combo expire. Continue until that combo earns 30,000 studs.

achievements.description: Maintain Max Stud Combo for 60 Seconds
achievements.summary: Keep the stud combo at its maximum for 60 seconds.

guide.context: Hyper Combo upgrades raise the maximum multiplier, up to ×4.

steps.text: Use @mechanic{Stud Magnet} and @mechanic{Stud Combo Duration}, then replay the Falcone club mission.
Break furniture and collect studs until the combo reaches your current maximum. Keep gathering studs for a full minute without the meter dropping.

achievements.summary: Build a single combat chain of at least 99 hits.

steps.text: Play a combat AR Trial as Jim Gordon with the @item{Rebound Launcher}'s split-bolt upgrade. Fire into enemy groups while countering or dodging incoming attacks. Keep the chain active until it reaches 99.

guide.context: Being spotted ends stealth for that encounter. Replay a story mission at the Batcomputer for more attempts.

steps.text: Approach unaware enemies from behind and use the @mechanic{Stealth Takedown} prompt. Accumulate 100 takedowns across encounters.

achievements.description: Place a Pin on the Map

steps.text: Open the map, move the cursor to a destination and use the @mechanic{Place Pin} input.
Explore the city until 100 nearby collectibles or side activities have been added to your map.

achievements.description: Defeat every type of enemy once
achievements.summary: Defeat every enemy class at least once.

steps.text: Defeat the enemy classes introduced throughout the story: basic melee, blade, pistol, shield, shotgun, rapid-fire, brute, bomb, rocket, stun baton, hammer brute and shield brute.
Answer radio dispatches and red crime markers. Finish each displayed objective, including speaking to a rescued victim when prompted, until you have stopped 30 crimes.

achievements.description: Prevent each type of Crime in Gotham once

guide.context: Crime spawns vary; keep checking the objective label when a dispatch appears.

steps.text: After the story, answer red crime markers until you complete Mugging, Snatch and Run, Break-In, Scuffle, Citizens in Peril, Vandalism, Joyriders, Getaway Vehicle and GCPD Backup.
Complete both Ambush variants: the rocket-launcher group and the staged attack on a fake victim.
Use the vehicle grapple to stop Joyriders. For Getaway Vehicle, use missiles to break the armored car's protection, grapple the car and defeat its occupants.

achievements.summary: Glide through ten separate wind tunnels.

steps.text: After unlocking gliding at Wayne Enterprises, fly into the visible white air streams around Gotham. Travel a few meters inside each stream and use ten different tunnels.

achievements.summary: Escape Arkham Asylum in the Mayhem story.

steps.text: Finish the opening Arkham escape as Joker and Harley Quinn.
Speak to Joker-Mite in the hideout, build the @loc{Planning Table} and use the table to start a Mayhem Run.
Complete runs and return through extraction sewers five times.

achievements.summary: Recruit three henchpeople for one character’s crew.

steps.text: After the second Mayhem Run, follow the recruitment introduction to the hideout Gym. Buy locker space; the first slot costs 10,000 studs.
Recruit three henchpeople for either Joker or Harley. Keep the recruits until the achievement unlocks.

achievements.description: Purchase every power up once from the pop-up shop
achievements.summary: Buy each of the 20 Mayhem power-ups at least once.

guide.context: Use Joker-Mite’s Pop-Up Shops near North Island’s starting points and extraction sewers during runs. The first power-up in each run is free; buying one replaces that stock slot. Purchases count across runs. Permanent versions bought in the hideout already count and disappear from the run shops. Reroll is excluded.

achievements.summary: Steal all 14 hero vehicles in Mayhem Mode.

guide.context: Get the Vehicle Key power-up so you can drive. Buy the Monarch Theater starting point at the Planning Table. Start a run there, pass the pop-up shop and turn left at the road to find one or two hero vehicles. Steal the vehicles you still need, extract and repeat runs for different spawns.

achievements.summary: Personally defeat 300 A.R.G.U.S. agents across Mayhem Runs.

steps.text: Defeat A.R.G.U.S. agents during repeated runs. Use your own weapons and power-ups for the kills instead of relying on summoned crew.

achievements.description: Have 10 crew members summoned at once
achievements.summary: Have ten crew members active at the same time.

guide.context: You can recruit the same unlocked henchperson type for both characters; more recruits appear in the Gym.

steps.text: When a Mayhem Run announces that A.R.G.U.S. has captured a prisoner, go to the @mechanic{Rescue} marker and defeat the guards. Repeat rescue events until you unlock @npc{Brute}.
In the hideout Gym, buy the five lockers on each side: four regular lockers and one large locker for each character.
Speak to Brute in the wrestling ring and recruit him as Joker. Switch to Harley and recruit the next Brute who appears in the ring.
Recruit four regular henchpeople for Joker and four for Harley. Check that a crew member occupies each of the ten lockers.
Start a run and build Focus for both characters. During a fight, summon one crew, switch characters and immediately summon the other crew while the first five are still alive.

achievements.description: Purchase every piece of equipment from the Joker-Mite shop
achievements.summary: Buy all ten permanent Joker-Mite equipment upgrades.

guide.context: The suits sold by Joker-Mite are excluded from this achievement.

steps.text: Visit @npc{Joker-Mite} inside the hideout and buy every permanent equipment upgrade. The full set costs 2,245,000 studs.
At the boarded doorway to the right of Joker-Mite's hideout shop, choose @mechanic{Purchase} and pay 100,000 studs for the Theater expansion.

achievements.summary: Finish the Mayhem story by attending the Villy Awards.

steps.text: Finish the main objective chains: build the Bat-signals, complete the Clowns objectives and place the Jack-in-the-boxes. Finish the Radio signals and Fireworks objectives too.
Watch the Villy Awards scene and return to the hideout stud pit.

achievements.summary: Extract through each of the four Mayhem sewer exits.

steps.text: Use a different corner's sewer extraction point on successive runs until you have escaped through all four. Keep track of the corners already used.

achievements.description: Reroll 5 Bonus Activities at the Planning Table
achievements.summary: Reroll five Bonus Activities at the Planning Table.

guide.context: You can spread rerolls across runs to avoid paying the higher prices in one planning session.

steps.text: After the third run, open the @loc{Planning Table} and hold the displayed reroll input to replace a Bonus Activity. Make five rerolls in total.
